title: Honey-Glazed Italian Apples Galette
description: A sweet and tangy Italian-inspired dessert featuring crispy Braeburn apples, miso-marinated for an added depth of flavor.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together miso paste and honey until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine sliced apples and miso-honey mixture; let it sit for 15-20 minutes.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out almond flour to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Arrange the marinated apple slices in a spiral pattern, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Dot the top of the apples with unsalted butter pieces.
Fold the edges of the almond flour dough over the apples, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the egg wash over the dough to give it a golden glaze.
Sprinkle with salt and garnish with a sprig of fresh thyme.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Let the galette cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
